register.formality: です・ます調 (polite). Buttons and labels are noun phrases or plain verbs (保存, 削除); sentences end in です/ます.
register.note: Full-width punctuation (、。) in running text. A sentence-final ellipsis is "…" (one character). A {placeholder} in running text takes no surrounding spaces; Latin words (Motir, Sprint) keep a half-width space only where Japanese UIs normally put one.

Sprint.source: messages/zh.json issueViews.sprint ("Sprint", kept Latin) and story MOTIR-7730 copy rules
Sprint.note: Kept in Latin script by decision, in every language. DELIBERATE: Japanese Jira writes スプリント; Motir keeps the Latin "Sprint" as Chinese already does, knowing that convention. Do not write スプリント.

work item.allowedSenses: 'card' (and its translation) stays correct for a PAYMENT card (billing) and a UI PANEL (a dashboard or board card component) — the same senses tests/i18n-catalog.test.ts's CARD_SENSE_ALLOWLIST allows in en and zh. It is banned only as a name for a work item.
